args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back**: checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all three production regions — rollback verified (no change-manager approval needed, since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production).
3. **Opened incident**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** created for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback action; this paged the on-call engineer.

The service should now recover on v2.3.0. I'd recommend monitoring error rates over the next few minutes to confirm the rollback resolved the health-check failures.
